features_page.smart_templates_content:
❓ WHAT DOES THIS FEATURE DO?

Every time the bot sends a message, the content is slightly
transformed so each message looks unique — Discord won't
detect it as a repeated bot message.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔧 5 AUTO-TRANSFORMATION METHODS:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

① SPINTAX — Randomly pick one from multiple options
   → You type:  Hello {everyone|guys|folks}
   → Bot sends: "Hello everyone"  or
                "Hello guys"       or
                "Hello folks"
   Each send randomly picks 1 of the options.

② RANDOM EMOJI — Auto-inserts an emoji mid-sentence (30%)
   → "Hello everyone" may become "Hello 🔥 everyone"

③ EXTRA SPACES — Adds an extra space between words (20%)
   → "Hello world" may become "Hello  world"
   (Invisible to readers, but Discord sees it as a new string)

④ RANDOM CAPITALIZATION — Changes casing randomly (30%)
   → "hello" may become "HELLO" or "Hello"

⑤ ABBREVIATIONS — Auto-shortens common words (40%)
   → "you"  → "u"
   → "okay" → "ok" or "k"
   → "everyone" → "everyone" or "folks"

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✏️  HOW TO USE SPINTAX (MOST IMPORTANT)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Syntax:  {option 1|option 2|option 3}
         (use | to separate each option)

Example — type this into your message list:
  {Hello|Hi|Hey} {everyone|guys}, how are you {doing|today}?

Bot will send variations like:
  → "Hello everyone, how are you doing?"
  → "Hi guys, how are you today?"
  → "Hey everyone, how are you doing? 🎉"

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 TIPS FOR BEST RESULTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✅  1-2 spintax blocks per message is plenty
✅  Use natural, casual language — sound like a real person
✅  Combine with Auto Typing for maximum effectiveness
❌  Don't make the entire message spintax — it will look unnatural
